note: The chart shows the Lower 48 battery discharge, daily mean of the week, for each of the 104 weeks held, which ran from 9188.86 MWh a day (2024-11-04 to 2024-11-10) to 56102.57 MWh a day (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-06).
